title: Fate Marable
summary: Greer recalls meeting Marable in St. Louis and the riverboat band.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Now what about -- how did you and Fate Marabel become friends?
Well, Fate was a big man, nice man, a ...Fate Marable was
night hawk. And he crossed me on one of my rampages. We were drinking and --
You mean when you first met him?
In St. Louis, yeah. Oh, the trumpet player introduced me to him before that. What is his name, one of his -- you know his name? Did you know any of the guys who played for Fate?
All I know was that Louis Armstrong played with him a certain time, I think Jabbo Smith played with him for a little while.
Who else? Another boy from New Orleans.

No. But anyway, this trumpet player, me and him was in the bar and Fate come in and this boy, "Hey, Chief, come here, I want you to meet somebody." So that's how I met him. And he was such a pleasant guy from then on. He was my drinking man, because he used to ask me a lot of questions about the band and -- Fate Marable, him and his gin. We was close.
How did you like his band?

In fact, I'll tell you the truth. I never heard his band entirely. I never been around one of them riverboats. I was invited but I was always too busy. In fact, a lot of us, me and Duke, we never made it. We was so busy, you know.
But a lot of guys come from that band. A lot of
good ones come from that band. He always had guys that could play. I think Zutty played with him.
Yeah, I think he did for a while.
